description: Generate a morning brief summarizing recent wiki activity with [N] citations. Default 24h lookback. Does not email — for that use the web UI Settings → Daily Brief → Send Now.

include_on_this_day.description: Include an "On This Day" section for pages created exactly 1w/1m/1y ago

since_hours.description: How many hours back to look for recent pages (default 24, max 168)

name: generate_daily_brief
